english.heading: Plant Selection and Guilds
body: Choose plants that work together—and change the planting as it grows.

body.text: Kies plante wat saamwerk—en verander die aanplanting soos dit groei.

english.heading: Plant Selection and Guilds
body: A fruit tree needs light, water, soil nutrients and room. Support plants can supply food, leafy mulch, flowers and living cover.  Give each plant a useful job. Keep observing whether it helps the tree and the household. Which jobs does your planting need?

body.text: 'n Vrugteboom het lig, water, voedingstowwe in die grond en ruimte nodig. Ondersteuningsplante kan kos, blaarryke deklaag, blomme en lewende bedekking verskaf.  Gee elke plant 'n nuttige taak. Hou aan om waar te neem of dit die boom en die huishouding help. Watter take het jou aanplanting nodig?

english.heading: Start With the Site
body: Find out what is limiting growth before choosing a plant.

body.text: Vind uit wat groei beperk voordat jy 'n plant kies.

english.heading: Start With the Site
body: Check sunlight, drainage, soil condition and water availability. Nitrogen is only one possible limitation.  Compare the soil beneath mulch with exposed soil. Choose support plants that fit the actual conditions. What does this site need first?

body.text: Kontroleer sonlig, dreinering, die toestand van die grond en hoeveel water beskikbaar is. Stikstof is net een moontlike beperking.  Vergelyk die grond onder deklaag met grond wat blootgestel is. Kies ondersteuningsplante wat by die werklike toestande pas. Wat het hierdie terrein eerste nodig?

english.heading: Give Every Plant a Job
body: A useful guild produces benefits you can observe.

body.text: 'n Nuttige gilde lewer voordele wat jy kan waarneem.

english.heading: Give Every Plant a Job
body: Choose members for food, nitrogen fixation, mulch, flowers or ground cover. One plant may do several jobs.  By the end, plan a guild, explain how residues feed soil, and decide which support plants to keep, cut or remove. Which job is still missing?

body.text: Kies lede vir kos, stikstofbinding, deklaag, blomme of grondbedekking. Een plant kan verskeie take doen.  Beplan teen die einde 'n gilde, verduidelik hoe reste die grond voed, en besluit watter ondersteuningsplante jy hou, sny of verwyder. Watter taak ontbreek nog?

english.heading: Look for Root Nodules
body: Legumes work with rhizobia in nodules on their roots.

body.text: Peulplante werk saam met rhizobia in knoppies op hul wortels.

english.heading: Look for Root Nodules
body: These bacteria convert nitrogen from the air into forms the legume can use.  Find nodules on a spare legume plant. Nodulation and growth depend on the plant, suitable bacteria and growing conditions. Can you find the nodules?

body.text: Hierdie bakterieë sit stikstof uit die lug om in vorme wat die peulplant kan gebruik.  Soek knoppies op 'n peulplant wat jy kan ontbeer. Knopvorming en groei hang af van die plant, geskikte bakterieë en groeitoestande. Kan jy die knoppies vind?

english.heading: Return Leaves to the Soil
body: Nitrogen in plant material becomes useful as that material breaks down.

heading.text: Gee blare terug aan die grond

body.text: Stikstof in plantmateriaal word nuttig soos daardie materiaal afbreek.

english.heading: Return Leaves to the Soil
body: Return suitable leafy prunings, fallen leaves and crop residues as mulch. Soil organisms release nutrients during decomposition.  This takes time. A living legume is not an instant fertiliser pipe into the fruit tree. Which residues can you return?

heading.text: Gee blare terug aan die grond

body.text: Gee geskikte blaarryke snoeisels, afgevalle blare en oesreste as deklaag terug. Grondorganismes stel voedingstowwe vry terwyl die materiaal ontbind.  Dit neem tyd. 'n Lewende peulplant is nie 'n pyp wat kunsmis onmiddellik na die vrugteboom lei nie. Watter reste kan jy teruggee?

english.heading: Sesbania Has a Useful Role
body: Sesbania sesban can supply fast growth and leafy mulch.

body.text: Sesbania sesban kan vinnige groei en blaarryke deklaag lewer.

english.heading: Sesbania Has a Useful Role
body: It is indigenous to KwaZulu-Natal. In suitable warm conditions, manage this short-lived shrub or small tree as a support plant.  Allow room for its growth. Prune for mulch and reassess it when shade or water competition increases. Where could you manage its growth?

body.text: Dit is inheems aan KwaZulu-Natal. Bestuur hierdie kortlewende struik of klein boom in geskikte warm toestande as 'n ondersteuningsplant.  Laat plek vir sy groei. Snoei dit vir deklaag en beoordeel dit weer wanneer skadu of mededinging om water toeneem. Waar kan jy sy groei bestuur?

english.heading: Check the Full Plant Name
body: Sesbania sesban and Sesbania punicea are different species.

body.text: Sesbania sesban en Sesbania punicea is verskillende spesies.

english.heading: Check the Full Plant Name
body: Sesbania punicea is the invasive red sesbania. Its pods have four lengthwise wings. Confirm identity using reliable botanical guidance.  Check the full name before planting. Respect the agreed project species list, including any restriction on Sesbania sesban. Can the supplier verify the species?

body.text: Sesbania punicea is die indringende red sesbania. Sy peule het vier vlerke wat in die lengte loop. Bevestig die identiteit met betroubare botaniese leiding.  Kontroleer die volle naam voordat jy plant. Respekteer die ooreengekome spesielys van die projek, insluitend enige beperking op Sesbania sesban. Kan die verskaffer die spesie bevestig?

english.heading: Pigeon Pea Gives Food Too
body: Pigeon pea—Cajanus cajan—can provide peas, leafy material and nitrogen fixation.

body.text: Pigeon pea—Cajanus cajan—kan ertjies, blaarmateriaal en stikstofbinding verskaf.

english.heading: Pigeon Pea Gives Food Too
body: Use a sunny, freely draining position. It is a short-lived support shrub; frost and waterlogging can limit it.  Decide whether each plant mainly supplies peas or leafy material. Frequent severe cutting can damage it and reduce the food harvest. Are you growing this plant for peas or mulch?

body.text: Gebruik 'n sonnige plek wat goed dreineer. Dit is 'n kortlewende ondersteuningstruik; ryp en versuiping kan dit beperk.  Besluit of elke plant hoofsaaklik ertjies of blaarmateriaal moet lewer. Gereelde, erge terugsnoei kan dit beskadig en die voedseloes verminder. Kweek jy hierdie plant vir ertjies of vir deklaag?

english.heading: Choose for Place and Size
body: A useful support tree in one place may be too large or unsuitable in another.

body.text: 'n Ondersteuningsboom wat op een plek nuttig is, kan op 'n ander plek te groot of ongeskik wees.

english.heading: Choose for Place and Size
body: Compare mature crown, roots, shade, rainfall and temperature. Check locally appropriate species and planting rules.  Put large support trees where they have space. For a small young guild, a manageable shrub may be easier to maintain. How large will this plant become?

body.text: Vergelyk die volwasse kroon, wortels, skadu, reënval en temperatuur. Kontroleer watter spesies en plantreëls plaaslik gepas is.  Plaas groot ondersteuningsbome waar hulle ruimte het. Vir 'n klein, jong gilde kan 'n hanteerbare struik makliker wees om te onderhou. Hoe groot sal hierdie plant word?

english.heading: Annual Cover Has a Place
body: Sunn hemp can cover a suitable warm-season gap before the next crop.

body.text: Sunn hemp kan 'n geskikte gaping in die warm seisoen bedek voor die volgende gewas.

english.heading: Annual Cover Has a Place
body: Grow it where its season and space fit the plan. Its contribution depends on growth, nodulation and the material returned.  After cutting, allow for decomposition. An annual cover crop plays a different role from a longer-lived support shrub. When will this space be needed again?

body.text: Kweek dit waar sy seisoen en ruimte by die plan pas. Sy bydrae hang af van groei, knopvorming en die materiaal wat teruggegee word.  Laat ná die sny tyd vir ontbinding. 'n Eenjarige dekgewas speel 'n ander rol as 'n ondersteuningstruik wat langer leef. Wanneer sal hierdie ruimte weer nodig wees?

english.heading: Leave Room Around the Tree
body: Keep the young fruit tree in light and retain access for care.

body.text: Hou die jong vrugteboom in die lig en behou toegang vir versorging.

english.heading: Leave Room Around the Tree
body: Keep an open establishment basin and access to the fruit tree. Place temporary support plants where their size and water use can be managed.  Put leafy cuttings where mulch is needed. Neighbouring fruit trees can share support strips between them. Can you reach both plants as they grow?

body.text: Hou 'n oop vestigingskom en toegang tot die vrugteboom. Plaas tydelike ondersteuningsplante waar hul grootte en watergebruik bestuur kan word.  Sit blaarryke snoeisels waar deklaag nodig is. Naburige vrugtebome kan ondersteuningstroke tussen hulle deel. Kan jy albei plante bereik soos hulle groei?

english.heading: Build a Layered Support Guild
body: Combine seasonal cover, support shrubs and temporary small trees.

body.text: Kombineer seisoenale bedekking, ondersteuningstruike en tydelike klein bome.

english.heading: Build a Layered Support Guild
body: Cowpea covers sunny gaps. Pigeon pea provides food and leafy material. Managed Sesbania sesban can supply taller temporary support.  Add suitable flowering and mulch plants. Keep the mango trunk clear and manage light, water and access. Which layers fit your site?

body.text: Cowpea bedek sonnige gapings. Pigeon pea lewer kos en blaarmateriaal. Bestuurde Sesbania sesban kan hoër tydelike ondersteuning bied.  Voeg geskikte blom- en deklaagplante by. Hou die mango se stam vry en bestuur lig, water en toegang. Watter lae pas by jou terrein?

english.heading: How Many Support Plants?
body: Plan abundant support where the site and your care can sustain it.

body.text: Beplan oorvloedige ondersteuning waar die terrein en jou versorging dit kan volhou.

english.heading: How Many Support Plants?
body: Count woody supports across the spaces between fruit trees. Sow suitable ground cover by area.  There is no universal number per fruit tree. Adjust density to water, soil, plant size and your ability to prune and thin. How much support can you maintain?

body.text: Tel houtagtige ondersteuningsplante oor die ruimtes tussen vrugtebome. Saai geskikte grondbedekking volgens oppervlakte.  Daar is geen universele getal per vrugteboom nie. Pas die digtheid aan by water, grond, plantgrootte en jou vermoë om te snoei en uit te dun. Hoeveel ondersteuning kan jy onderhou?

english.heading: Chop-and-Drop for Light and Mulch
body: Watch the branch fall onto the cut leaves.

body.text: Kyk hoe die tak op die gesnyde blare val.

english.heading: Chop-and-Drop for Light and Mulch
body: Prune a support tree and return suitable leafy cuttings to the soil. The clip shows a branch cut: the support tree remains standing. Leave enough healthy foliage for the plant to recover.  Match cutting to the species. Avoid frequent severe cuts on pigeon pea, especially when growing it for peas. Which plant needs a cut—and how much?

body.text: Snoei 'n ondersteuningsboom en gee geskikte blaarryke snoeisels aan die grond terug. Die videogreep wys hoe 'n tak afgesny word: die ondersteuningsboom bly staan. Laat genoeg gesonde blare sodat die plant kan herstel.  Pas die snoei by die spesie aan. Vermy gereelde, erge terugsnoei van pigeon pea, veral wanneer jy dit vir ertjies kweek. Watter plant moet gesny word—en hoeveel?

english.heading: Keep Mulch Off the Trunk
body: Spread suitable cut material over the soil, with the trunk and root collar clear.

heading.text: Hou deklaag weg van die stam

body.text: Sprei geskikte gesnyde materiaal oor die grond, en hou die stam en wortelkraag vry.

english.heading: Keep Mulch Off the Trunk
body: Mulch protects the surface, helps conserve moisture and returns organic material.  Leave access for watering and inspection. Cut material into manageable pieces and keep observing moisture and decomposition. Is the root collar still clear?

heading.text: Hou deklaag weg van die stam

body.text: Deklaag beskerm die oppervlak, help om vog te bewaar en gee organiese materiaal terug.  Laat toegang vir natmaak en inspeksie. Sny materiaal in hanteerbare stukke en hou aan om vog en ontbinding waar te neem. Is die wortelkraag nog vry?

english.heading: Choose the Right Comfrey
body: Bocking 14 comfrey can supply cut leaves for mulch.

body.text: Bocking 14 comfrey kan gesnyde blare vir deklaag verskaf.

english.heading: Choose the Right Comfrey
body: Obtain the correct cultivar. Bocking 14 does not spread by viable seed, but root pieces can regrow.  Place it where it has room and sufficient moisture. Cut leaves as it recovers; do not crowd the young fruit tree. Is this a good permanent place for the clump?

body.text: Kry die korrekte kultivar. Bocking 14 versprei nie deur kiemkragtige saad nie, maar wortelstukke kan weer groei.  Plaas dit waar dit plek en genoeg vog het. Sny blare soos dit herstel; moenie die jong vrugteboom verdring nie. Is dit 'n goeie permanente plek vir die pol?

english.heading: Observe Helpful Insects
body: Flowers can provide resources for useful insects.

body.text: Blomme kan hulpbronne vir nuttige insekte verskaf.

english.heading: Observe Helpful Insects
body: Many ladybirds eat aphids; some parasitoid wasps attack crop pests. Flowering members such as African basil can add resources.  Watch which insects visit and whether damage changes. A flowering plant does not guarantee pest control. What is the insect actually doing?

body.text: Baie liewenheersbesies eet plantluise; sommige parasitoïede wespe val gewaspeste aan. Blommende lede soos African basil kan hulpbronne byvoeg.  Kyk watter insekte besoek en of die skade verander. 'n Blommende plant waarborg nie pesbeheer nie. Wat doen die insek werklik?

english.heading: Give Flowers Their Space
body: Wild garlic can be a flowering member where the site suits it.

body.text: Wild garlic kan 'n blommende lid wees waar die terrein daarby pas.

english.heading: Give Flowers Their Space
body: Tulbaghia violacea has narrow leaves and lilac flowers. Place a clump where it has light and room to grow.  Observe visiting insects. Do not promise that a ring of wild garlic will repel pests or cure an outbreak. Where can flowers grow without crowding?

body.text: Tulbaghia violacea het smal blare en lila blomme. Plaas 'n pol waar dit lig en plek het om te groei.  Neem besoekende insekte waar. Moenie belowe dat 'n kring wild garlic peste sal afweer of 'n uitbreking sal genees nie. Waar kan blomme groei sonder om ander plante te verdring?

english.heading: Bring the Jobs Together
body: Choose useful partners while protecting the mango's growing space.

body.text: Kies nuttige vennote en beskerm terselfdertyd die mango se groeiruimte.

english.heading: Bring the Jobs Together
body: Combine the support functions your site needs: nitrogen fixation, food, mulch, flowers and ground cover. Some plants serve several functions.  Keep the trunk area and path open. Reassess each member as the mango and its neighbours grow. Does each member have space and a job?

body.text: Kombineer die ondersteuningsfunksies wat jou terrein nodig het: stikstofbinding, kos, deklaag, blomme en grondbedekking. Sommige plante vervul verskeie funksies.  Hou die area om die stam en die paadjie oop. Beoordeel elke lid weer soos die mango en sy bure groei. Het elke lid ruimte en 'n taak?

english.heading: Food Cover Also Competes
body: Sweet potato can cover ground and provide food in a suitable sunny space.

body.text: Patats kan grond bedek en kos verskaf in 'n geskikte sonnige ruimte.

english.heading: Food Cover Also Competes
body: Keep its vines away from the young fruit tree and retain a route for care. Its roots also use water and nutrients.  Where resources are tight, compare living cover with an ordinary mulch basin. Is this cover helping the tree establish?

body.text: Hou die patats se rankers weg van die jong vrugteboom en behou 'n roete vir versorging. Hul wortels gebruik ook water en voedingstowwe.  Waar hulpbronne skaars is, vergelyk lewende bedekking met 'n gewone deklaagkom. Help hierdie bedekking die boom om te vestig?

english.heading: First, Establish the Guild
body: Start while the young fruit tree and its support plants have enough light and water.

body.text: Begin terwyl die jong vrugteboom en sy ondersteuningsplante genoeg lig en water het.

english.heading: First, Establish the Guild
body: Plant into a suitable season, mulch and maintain establishment water. Keep the access gap open.  Start with the number of support plants you can care for. Observe survival and growth before adding more. Can you care for every plant through establishment?

body.text: Plant in 'n geskikte seisoen, gooi deklaag en hou aan om water te gee totdat die plante gevestig is. Hou die toegangsgaping oop.  Begin met die getal ondersteuningsplante wat jy kan versorg. Neem oorlewing en groei waar voordat jy meer byvoeg. Kan jy elke plant deur die vestigingstydperk versorg?

english.heading: Thin as the Fruit Tree Grows
body: When pruning is no longer enough, reduce selected support plants. Cut down selected competing supports to open space. Suitable cut material can stay as mulch: this is thinning through chop-and-drop.  Manage regrowth to keep the opening. Check light, soil moisture and growth; thinning does not instantly stop root competition. Which support plants should now give way?

heading.text: Dun uit soos die vrugteboom groei

body.text: Wanneer snoei nie meer genoeg is nie, verminder geselekteerde ondersteuningsplante. Kap geselekteerde mededingende ondersteuningsplante af om ruimte oop te maak. Geskikte gesnyde materiaal kan as deklaag bly: dit is uitdunning deur kap-en-laat-val.  Bestuur hergroei om die opening te behou. Kontroleer lig, grondvog en groei; uitdunning stop nie wortelmededinging onmiddellik nie. Watter ondersteuningsplante moet nou plek maak?

english.heading: Move Support Into the Light
body: As shade increases, renew sun-loving support plants in open edges and younger plantings.

body.text: Soos skadu toeneem, vernuwe sonliewende ondersteuningsplante op oop rande en in jonger aanplantings.

english.heading: Move Support Into the Light
body: Carry useful prunings back to established trees. Keep nearby plants only where they still perform well.  Mature fruit trees still need nutrients. Monitor growth, harvest and soil conditions; support plants do not remove that need. Where is the next useful sunny space?

body.text: Dra nuttige snoeisels terug na gevestigde bome. Hou nabygeleë plante net waar hulle steeds goed presteer.  Volwasse vrugtebome het steeds voedingstowwe nodig. Monitor groei, oes en grondtoestande; ondersteuningsplante neem nie daardie behoefte weg nie. Waar is die volgende nuttige sonnige ruimte?

english.heading: Let Observation Decide
body: Keep a short record of how the guild performs.

body.text: Hou 'n kort rekord van hoe die gilde presteer.

english.heading: Let Observation Decide
body: Check fruit-tree growth, shade, soil moisture, useful harvests and pest damage. Note what was cut, returned or removed.  Use these observations to change the layout and care. A plant earns its place through what it does here. What evidence would make you change the guild?

body.text: Kontroleer die vrugteboom se groei, skadu, grondvog, nuttige oeste en pesskade. Teken aan wat gesny, teruggegee of verwyder is.  Gebruik hierdie waarnemings om die uitleg en versorging te verander. 'n Plant verdien sy plek deur wat dit hier doen. Watter bewyse sal jou die gilde laat verander?

english.heading: Plan One Real Guild
body: Choose one fruit tree and mark a layout you can manage.

body.text: Kies een vrugteboom en merk 'n uitleg af wat jy kan bestuur.

english.heading: Plan One Real Guild
body: Record the tree, site conditions and missing jobs. Name the support species fully, mark the starting number and leave access.  Write down what will trigger pruning or thinning. Agree the species list with the project team where required. Can someone else explain your plan back to you?

body.text: Teken die boom, die terreintoestande en die ontbrekende take aan. Gee die volle naam van elke ondersteuningspesie, merk die begingetal en laat toegang.  Skryf neer wat jou sal laat snoei of uitdun. Kom die spesielys met die projekspan ooreen waar dit vereis word. Kan iemand anders jou plan weer aan jou verduidelik?

english.heading: Plant, Observe, Adjust
body: Start one suitable guild and care for it through its first stage.

body.text: Begin een geskikte gilde en versorg dit deur sy eerste fase.

english.heading: Plant, Observe, Adjust
body: Use the right species, a manageable number of plants and room to grow. Return useful biomass and protect the fruit tree.  Review the planting as crowns expand. Keep, cut, replace or remove each support plant when its role changes. What will you do first—and when will you review it?

body.text: Gebruik die regte spesies, 'n hanteerbare getal plante en ruimte om te groei. Gee nuttige biomassa terug en beskerm die vrugteboom.  Hersien die aanplanting soos die boomkrone uitbrei. Hou, sny, vervang of verwyder elke ondersteuningsplant wanneer sy rol verander. Wat sal jy eerste doen—en wanneer sal jy dit hersien?
